update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.32 - Breeding plan auto-advance
Features --- - Multi-generation breeding plans auto-advance between runs (trainee, bundle, borrow, factors, scenario) - Gen 2+ can use the previous generation's trainee as legacy parent (usePreviousAsLegacy) - Bot start applies Gen 1 settings and sets multi-run count from breeding plan length - Goal queue patches include target factor skills and legacy parent pair for Kotlin
Includes v5.9.30 cold start fix and prior parent-farming updates.
